schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS proof_set (
  slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (slot = 1),
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  set_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  pounds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 40,
  reps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8 CHECK (reps >= 0),
  completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (completed IN (0, 1)),
  completion_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (completion_attempts >= 0)
)

read:
WITH clock(now) AS (VALUES(CAST(? AS REAL)))
SELECT session_id, set_id, pounds, reps, completed, completion_attempts,
       rest_deadline, rest_skipped_at,
       CASE WHEN rest_deadline IS NULL THEN 'not_started'
            WHEN rest_skipped_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'skipped'
            WHEN rest_deadline <= (SELECT now FROM clock) THEN 'expired'
            ELSE 'running' END AS rest_state,
       CASE WHEN rest_deadline IS NULL OR rest_skipped_at IS NOT NULL
                 OR rest_deadline <= (SELECT now FROM clock) THEN 0
            ELSE rest_deadline - (SELECT now FROM clock) END AS rest_remaining_seconds
FROM proof_set WHERE slot = 1
increment:
UPDATE proof_set SET reps = reps + 1
WHERE slot = 1 AND session_id = ? AND set_id = ? AND completed = 0
complete:
UPDATE proof_set
SET rest_deadline = CASE WHEN completed = 0 THEN CAST(? AS REAL) + 20.0 ELSE rest_deadline END,
    completed = 1, completion_attempts = completion_attempts + 1
WHERE slot = 1 AND session_id = ? AND set_id = ?
